sources.citation: Roulon-Doko, Paulette. 2020. Introduction sur les langues oubanguiennes. ILARA lecture slides (Introduction aux langues d'Afrique). HAL halshs-03075359.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Gbaya-centred overview of Ubangian ('Langue tonale H, B, HB, BH'); no mention of Geme or the Zande group's prosody; no stress statement.

sources.citation: Boyd, Raymond. 1995. De l'expression à l'expressivité en morphologie: analyse comparée de la dérivation verbale en zande et en nzakala. Afrikanistische Arbeitspapiere 43: 5-36. HAL hal-00321166.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Zande and Nzakara verbal derivation only; a full-text search for stress/accent gèmé/jèmé/accent/stress finds nothing; no Geme data.

sources.citation: Boyd, Raymond. 1988. Le kpatiri ou gbayi, une nouvelle langue du groupe ngbandi. In Yves Moñino (ed.), Lexique comparatif des langues oubanguiennes, 35-49. Paris: Geuthner. HAL hal-00344525 (author version with added comments).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Sister chapter of the same volume, about Kpatiri/Gbayi (Ngbandi group), not Geme; it cites two Geme words for comparison (geme wílì 'arbre', geme mbÓgÒ 'colline', §3) and describes Kpatiri prosody purely as lexical tone (tons, schèmes tonals H/B/HB); the word 'accent' never occurs. Nothing on Geme stress.

sources.citation: Wikipedia (en, fr) 'Geme language' / 'Geme'; Glottolog 5.x languoid geme1244; Wikidata Q3915851; BnF catalogue record of Moñino (ed.) 1988 (146 p., ISBN 2-7053-0353-7)
sources.note: Stubs/records only: ~550 speakers (1996), two villages north of Ndélé (dialects Geme Tulu, Geme Kulagbolu); all cite Moñino 1988 / Boyd & Nougayrol 1988 as the only description. Nothing on phonology or stress.
